findings.description: The new build script type-checks only non-test `src` files. The merge gate's only root type-check runs through `build`, so after this change no test file is type-checked by the gate.
findings.body:
**After this change the merge gate type-checks no test file.**

The gate runs exactly three root stages: `build`, `test` and `lint` (`const GATE_STAGES: GateStage[] = ['build', 'test', 'lint'];` in `src/adapters/typescript.adapter.ts`). `gateCommands` runs the package.json script with the same name as each stage. The root `typecheck` script is never run, because the `typecheck` stage exists only for nested packages (`NESTED_STAGES`, `merge-gate.service.ts` L2574-2578).

Before this PR, `build` was a bare `tsc` over `include: ["src"]` with no exclude, so the gate's build stage type-checked every `src/**/*.test.ts`. The new build is:

```json
"build": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json",
```

`tsconfig.build.json` sets `include: ["src"]` and `exclude: ["src/**/*.test.ts"]`. That covers neither the test files still in `src/` nor anything under `test/`. The other two stages don't fill the gap: `vitest run` strips types without checking them, and `lint` is `biome check . && bash scripts/adr-index.sh --check`. The only workflow in `.github/workflows/` is the review workflow.

Result: a test with a type error (wrong call signature, stale fixture type, bad `@src`/`@test` import) now passes the gate and lands. Before this PR it failed `build`. The `pnpm typecheck covers test/` acceptance criterion holds, but only the local Stop hook runs that script.

To restore the coverage and keep `dist` free of tests, run the full type-check as part of `build` (`pnpm typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` also works and doesn't repeat the command).

findings.description: docs/conventions/testing.md:21-22 says '`src/` keeps relative imports; an alias never appears in a file under `src/`', but this PR adds `import { tempDir } from '@test/helpers/temp-dir.mock.js'` to 34 colocated tests under src/. Nothing breaks, because tsconfig.build.json excludes src/**/*.test.ts and sets paths {}. Either use the relative `../../test/helpers/temp-dir.mock.js` until each area moves, or have the convention say that tests still under src/ during the migration are exempt.

ADR 0100 still says '`tempDir(prefix)` in `src/test/temp-dir.mock.ts` is the one way a test makes a temp directory'. The helper is now test/helpers/temp-dir.mock.ts, and this is the only reference to the old path left in the repo.
The convention still says "`pnpm build` is a bare `tsc`", but build is now `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json` (the point about no specifier rewriting still holds).

The transitional comment `// Both trees while the tests move out of src/ (decision 116).` will go stale once the move completes; saying what removes it (e.g. "drop `src/**` once no test lives there") would make it hold up better.

testing.md (lines 3-22) and naming.md (lines 121-129) state the mirrored test/unit layout as already in force, while about 33 test files still sit beside their subjects in src/; the docs don't note the migration in progress.
